definitions.explanation: Published or occurring every three months.

{季刊|きかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学術|がくじゅつ}→学術：12280_gakujutsu⟧⟦{誌|し}→誌：noentry⟧

examples.english: Our quarterly report is published every year in March, June, September, and December.

notes:
Composed of {季|き} (season) + {刊|かん} (publication). Literally "published by season" — once every three months, four times a year.
